description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply & Higher Education - Order to acquire the land in Sewagama, Thamankaduwa D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District for under ground water project and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2034/07 of 28.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a public project. It specifically describes the acquisition of an immovable property (land) for the construction of a water reservoir, including detailed land description (plot number, extent, boundaries, location details). While it mentions a government minister (Rauff Hakeem) and references a legal act, the core content is about land acquisition and property description, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
